requirements.obligation: Validate options and platform before effects; preview performs local discovery and exits before terminal, staging or installation, with legacy/no-target refusals and unresolved remote choices.
requirements.expected: No confirmations or staging; eligible plans only, explicit non-success for no eligible target; ask/version/path stay unresolved.
requirements.observed: Retained Linux ten offline cases and Windows ten dry/refusal cases per host record zero effects and unchanged subjects. Source returns before terminal acquisition and staging; ask remains unresolved.
requirements.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirements.obligation: Offline preview makes no metadata, provider, download or network availability requests and does not adopt cached metadata as authority.
requirements.expected: Zero network-boundary calls; release/cache helpers suppress before returning metadata or artifact paths.
requirements.observed: Retained Windows guard suites pass 10/10 each, including preloaded metadata. Whole-entry cached/source cases show zero effects. Current guards precede cached metadata lookup; no preview network path was identified.
requirements.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirements.obligation: Guard every alternate effect site, including staging, writes, copy, removal, extraction, clipboard, browser launch and cleanup; suppressed copy must be false.
requirements.expected: No helper effects or sentinel changes; no successful Copied claim under preview.
requirements.observed: Retained Bash helper and Windows 10/10 guard suites pass; clipboard returns false and cached sentinels remain unchanged. Current guards are before effects and cache returns.
requirements.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirements.obligation: Return no usable artifact from preview helpers and prevent expansion, copy or store fallback from consuming proposed paths.
requirements.expected: Preview prints its own plan; guarded download/preset/extraction/install/import never pass a pretend existing file.
requirements.observed: Retained guards show null/false or empty artifact stdout with no effects. Current entry bypasses those artifact-returning helpers.
requirements.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirements.obligation: Cover fresh and cached Chromium/Firefox, metadata/unpacked/preset sentinels, store/ask/fallback, already installed, missing preset, mixed/legacy/zero and malformed options.
requirements.expected: All preview branches remain plans; cached sentinels unchanged; no store opening or installed confirmation.
requirements.observed: Retained whole-entry matrices cover fresh/cached/store/ask/installed/mixed/legacy/none/missing-preset/bad-option. The entry return makes metadata-error fallback unreachable in preview; separate real Install helper guards cover ask/fallback suppression.
requirements.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirements.obligation: Combine independent subject filesystem snapshots with effect/transport interception; separate harness logs and host startup writes from installer state.
requirements.expected: Subject names/modes/contents unchanged and zero effect calls, including cached/unpacked/preset state; denied network transport.
requirements.observed: Retained Linux and Windows observations record snapshotUnchanged=true and zero effects. Logs/readiness are outside the subject. CLR startup caches are separately recorded; this proves zero installer effects, not zero OS activity.
requirements.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirements.obligation: Normal positive and NO_OPEN/NoOpen controls must still reach exact downloads, staging, configuration, clipboard and manual consumers.
requirements.expected: Opening alone is suppressed under NoOpen; normal operations remain reachable with correct arguments.
requirements.observed: Retained Linux normal/NO_OPEN counts are 28/24; Windows counts are 21/17 per host. Exact configured preset, assets, copy, metadata, extraction and manual manager/new-tab assertions pass.
requirements.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirements.obligation: Detect eager initialization, cached early return, preview copy and EXIT cleanup mutants, using the relevant cached/positive controls and excluding bootstrap failures.
requirements.expected: Each valid mutant fails its specific effect or changed-sentinel oracle; normal positives remain healthy.
requirements.observed: Retained eight Bash and six Windows mutation controls are source-bound. Direct native eager/copy mutants reject sixteen dry cases across both hosts while all four normal/NoOpen positives pass; filesystem and clipboard-only effects are distinguished.
requirements.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirements.obligation: Qualify complete whole-entry behavior on actual Apple Bash 3.2/macOS and modern Linux, plus exact-file native PS5.1/supported7 after launch prerequisites.
requirements.expected: Actual claimed platforms execute preview/refusal/cache and normal-positive matrices; no emulated-host substitution.
requirements.observed: Retained modern Linux 23 cases and native Windows 24 direct cases bind unchanged source. Actual Apple/macOS remains explicitly BLOCKED; GNU stat, disabled mapfile or PLATFORM=mac helper execution is not equivalent.
requirements.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirements.obligation: Join the private staging/lifetime, normal terminal input and Windows encoding/selector interfaces without allowing preview initializer or cleanup effects.
requirements.expected: One composed source preserves the sibling contracts; individual interfaces are assessed rather than administrative issue states.
requirements.observed: Delivered installers and native fixtures match reviewed objects. Early return precedes normal terminal/staging and cleanup is guarded. Actual Mac prerequisite interfaces remain unqualified.
requirements.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirements.obligation: Keep mode-specific completion honest: would/unresolved/preview-only, explicit refusal, dashboard replacement warning, and normal manual installation/import pending.
requirements.expected: No swallowed error or empty eligible set becomes installed success; preview describes unresolved facts.
requirements.observed: Current source prints the required would/unresolved, warning and pending messages. Retained controls assert those messages alongside post-state; no real browser installation is claimed.
requirements.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirements.obligation: Keep both script usage and README/builder exposure consistent about offline, no effects, no artifacts, no prompts, unresolved choices, and NoOpen behavior.
requirements.expected: Public README states DRY_RUN=1/-DryRun and the same precise policy as actual script headers.
requirements.observed: Script headers accurately describe offline preview. Delivered README has no DRY_RUN/-DryRun/offline instructions in the installer section. Builder comment L372 refers to local/offline instructions that README does not supply.
requirements.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirements.obligation: Preserve preset configuration, manual dashboard boundary, card and permissions; apply only the later outer-wrapper amendment.
requirements.expected: Keep the original configuration/manual permission contract and 325x530 card under the 330x534 wrapper amendment.
requirements.observed: The supplied owner amendment permits a production 330x534 iframe around the 325x530 card. Only the older wrapper-size obligation is superseded; card size, geolocation scope, encoding and readability remain binding. The audited source currently uses 325x530 snippets. This review does not demand a geometry change for an unrelated installer/docs issue. No UI or network policy change is proposed by this preview repair.
requirements.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirements.obligation: Bind the delivered public script/document and generated-command source bytes to the exact reviewed target.
requirements.expected: Pinned raw and Pages acquisitions return HTTP 200 with exact target SHA256 for each named owner; preserve all separately mapped native, behavior, text and rendered obligations.
requirements.observed: Primary public-document-distribution.json records HTTP 200 and expected=observed SHA256 at both origins for install.sh, install.ps1, README.md, builder.html, config.js. E independently compared those expected hashes with immutable Git bytes. The exact installer bytes reuse their existing native parser/consumer receipts. Byte identity settles distribution only; remaining cells retain their own gaps.
requirements.evidence_basis: Fresh primary public acquisition, independently rebound by E to exact Git source; no repeated HTTP or new native execution by E.
